newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Powercor gives contract to Westpac.
newsitem.headline: Powercor gives contract to Westpac.

text.p: Powercor Australia Ltd, the largest electricity distributor and retailer in the state of Victoria, said on Tuesday that it had awarded its transaction banking business to Westpac Banking Corp.
Powercor said the decision was made after a review of submission from five banks.
Powercor said it had inherited its banking arrangements from the State Electricity Commission Victoria, which had banked with the National Australia Bank Ltd for over 75 years.

"While pricing was important, it was not the sole criteria for Westpac's selection," said Shane Breheny, Powercor's Chief Financial Officer. "Also of importance was its innovation, in particular in the area of new technology," he said.
Powercor Australia Ltd was one of the five electricity distribution businesses created by the Victorian government's restructure of the State Electricity Commission in 1994.
The company is owned by the U.S. electricity giant PacifiCorp. Powercor retails electricity to more than 547,000 customers in New South Wales and Victoria.
